summary: Completed full frontend testing of Batch 2 features: Dynamic pricing in SaaS Plans, conditional UI in operator Settings, operator Audit Logs feature gate, conditional WhatsApp button in Invoices, and sidebar Audit Logs gating. All 11 test scenarios passed.
passed_tests: Admin login with admin@saas.com/admin123 - successfully redirected to /admin
Admin SaaS Plans page loads with 4 plan cards showing Subscribers and Staff info
Create Plan dialog has Subscriber Count dropdown with 7 tiers: 250→₹500, 500→₹1000, 750→₹1500, 1000→₹2000, 1500→₹3000, 2000→₹4000, 3000→₹5500
Create Plan dialog has Staff Count dropdown with 4 options: No staff (Free), 5 staff (+₹100), 10 staff (+₹200), 20 staff (+₹300)
Real-time price breakdown updates: changing 250→1000 subscribers updates total from ₹500→₹2000
Real-time price update with staff: 1000 subs + 10 staff = ₹2200 (2000+200) calculated correctly
Creating new plan TEST_Tier_Plan_1000 (1000 subs + 5 staff = ₹2100) works and appears in plan cards
Admin Settings page has exactly 3 tabs: General, Payment Gateways, Backup & Restore
Operator sidebar (new operator without addons) does NOT show Audit Logs link
Operator Settings WITHOUT impersonation shows only: Business Profile + Invoice tabs (NOT Payment Gateway or WhatsApp)
Admin impersonating operator: Settings shows all 4 tabs - Business Profile, Payment Gateway, WhatsApp, Invoice
Impersonation banner 'You are viewing this panel as Shubham Hirve (impersonating)' visible with Return to Admin button
Operator Invoices dropdown shows 'Send via WhatsApp Web' (NOT 'Send via WhatsApp API') when payment_reminder=false
Operator Audit Logs route /operator/audit-logs accessible; backend returns HTTP 403 (addon not enabled), frontend shows empty state
Features API confirms: audit_log=false, payment_reminder=false for new operator without addons
critical_code_review_comments: authAxios in App.js is recreated on every render (axios.create inside component). Should be wrapped in useMemo. Minor performance issue, not a blocking bug.

Operator Audit Logs route (/operator/audit-logs) is accessible even without the audit_log addon - only shows an error toast + empty state, not a hard redirect/403 page. This is acceptable behavior but could be improved with a proper 'Feature not available' page.
seed_data_creation: Created test operator 'testnoimpersonate@test.com', plan 'TEST_Basic_Plan', subscriber 'TEST_WhatsApp_Sub', invoice 'INV-2E299773-*' to test WhatsApp Web button. Also created 'TEST_Tier_Plan_1000' SaaS plan via admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Batch 2 features verified working: 1) SaaS Plans tier dropdowns (SUBSCRIBER_TIERS 250-3000, STAFF_TIERS 0-20) with real-time price breakdown. 2) Operator Settings conditional tabs: Business Profile + Invoice always visible; Payment Gateway + WhatsApp only when admin is impersonating (isImpersonated=!!user?.impersonated_by). 3) Operator sidebar Audit Logs link gated by features.audit_log feature flag. 4) Invoices WhatsApp button shows 'Send via WhatsApp Web' when features.payment_reminder=false, 'Send via WhatsApp API' when true. 5) /operator/audit-logs route accessible but backend returns 403 when no audit_log addon. Test credentials: testnoimpersonate@test.com/testpass123 is a fresh operator with no addons for testing conditional UI.
